newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter securities, credit earnings rise.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter securities, credit earnings rise.

text.p: Dean Witter, Discover & Co on Wednesday said securities earnings were $119.0 million in the third quarter, 12 percent higher than the year-ago figure of $106.7 million.
Earnings from credit services rose seven percent to $120.0 million from $112.0 million in the year-ago quarter, despite an industry-wide trend of rising credit card writeoffs, the company said.
Dean Witter said return on equity was 18.6 percent for the last 12 months.
The company today reported third quarter results of $1.41 per share, compared with a First Call estimate of $1.36 and year-ago third quarter earnings of $1.23.
